prd_facts.fact: A customer can ask for an alert only on a product with nothing available; otherwise it is refused with in_stock.
Asking twice for the same product returns the same alert.
A customer has at most 10 alerts waiting (not yet notified); the 11th is refused with too_many_alerts.
When stock arrives for a product that had nothing available, every waiting alert is marked notified and the customer gets the back_in_stock email.
A notified alert is not sent again; a new request after being notified creates a new alert.
The notification rules list the new back_in_stock template.
The PRD has a new stock alerts section with rules ALR-01 to ALR-05.
